Tomato Early Blight.symptoms: Concentric rings with yellow halos creating target spots on older lower foliage.
Tomato Early Blight.idealConditions: Warm temperatures (24-29°C) with frequent wet canopy conditions.

Tomato Late Blight.symptoms: Dark water-soaked lesions with white mold fuzz under high humidity.
Tomato Late Blight.idealConditions: Cool, humid weather (15-20°C) with persistent dampness.

Rice Leaf Blast.symptoms: Spindle/diamond-shaped lesions with grayish centers and dark borders.
Rice Leaf Blast.idealConditions: High humidity (>90%) with heavy nitrogen fertilizer application.

Cotton Leaf Spot.symptoms: Small circular reddish-brown necrotic spots with purple margins.
Cotton Leaf Spot.idealConditions: Intermittent rain followed by warm sunny periods.

Potato Early Blight.symptoms: Brown circular spots with concentric rings on mature lower leaves.
Potato Early Blight.idealConditions: Warm days alternating with high dew and wet foliage.

Healthy Tomato Leaf.symptoms: Uniform vibrant green color, intact margins, active photosynthesis, no lesions.
Healthy Tomato Leaf.idealConditions: Balanced sunlight, proper irrigation, and healthy nutrient levels.
